meals.title: Turkey, vegetables and rice
meals.portion_notes: Half a dinner for two: cooked ground turkey (about 125 g estimated), bok choy, one king oyster mushroom, one egg, rice and oil. Half a cup rice assumed dry for the whole recipe; user share one-quarter cup dry. Two tablespoons oil total; user share one tablespoon. Turkey weight and fat percentage uncertain. If rice was measured cooked, this share would be about 120 kcal lower.
meals.estimate_note: Nutrition is approximate; label-based for shakes, visual estimates for mixed meals.

meals.title: Pizza and black coffee
meals.portion_notes: One thick, deep-dish-style cheese-and-tomato pizza slice with a small white-cheese topping, plus one mug of black coffee. Full pictured serving assumed eaten; coffee assumed unsweetened, with no milk. Exact slice weight, cheese type and amount, and added oil unknown.
meals.estimate_note: Visual estimate, not a weighed serving or restaurant nutrition label. Pizza style and white-cheese topping are inferred from appearance; nutrition may change with portion or ingredient clarification.

meals.title: Protein shake and coconut water
meals.portion_notes: One full Premier Protein chocolate shake carton, 11 fl oz (325 ml), and one full Kirkland Signature organic coconut water carton, 330 ml, assumed consumed. Shake front label shows 160 calories and 30 g protein; coconut water estimated at 60 calories.
meals.estimate_note: Products and carton sizes identified from the photo. Shake calories and protein are label-visible. Coconut water nutrition and combined carbohydrate/fat values are approximate because the full nutrition panels are not visible; formulation differences may change these slightly.

meals.title: Wooly Pig Asian Cubano
meals.portion_notes: One whole toasted Asian Cubano sandwich, pictured cut into two halves, assumed eaten. No side or drink visible or included. Wooly Pig menu lists char siu ham, pulled pork, provolone, cilantro pesto and house pickles on ciabatta. Bread weight, meat and cheese portions, and added butter or oil are unknown.
meals.estimate_note: Approximate visual and ingredient-based estimate, not official restaurant nutrition. Ingredients checked against Wooly Pig's menu; portions and preparation fats were not weighed. Counts only the individual pictured sandwich.

meals.title: Premier Protein chocolate shake
meals.portion_notes: One full 11 fl oz (325 ml) carton assumed consumed. Front label shows 160 calories and 30 g protein.
meals.estimate_note: Calories and protein visible on the carton; carbohydrate and fat from the manufacturer's 11 fl oz chocolate-shake nutrition information. Full carton assumed; label rounding and formulation differences may slightly affect values.

meals.title: RT Rotisserie wings, half chicken and squash
meals.portion_notes: Three pictured wing pieces, one half rotisserie chicken, and one-third of the pictured half-squash serving (one-sixth of a whole squash). Chicken skin assumed eaten. Includes the squash's proportional creamy topping, seeds and roasting oil, plus an assumed modest two tablespoons total dipping sauce; not both full sauce bowls. No background drinks or other dishes counted.
meals.estimate_note: Approximate visual portion-based estimate, not official restaurant nutrition. The restaurant menu confirms half rotisserie chicken with sauces; exact edible chicken weight, wing size/coating, oil and sauce consumption are unknown. Only the stated portions are counted, not all photographed wings or squash.

meals.title: Bacon and hard-boiled eggs
meals.portion_notes: Four strips of Kirkland Signature bacon and two hard-boiled eggs. Bacon label serving is two slices (18 g); four strips counted as two servings. Eggs assumed large. No additional cooking fat or toppings counted.
meals.estimate_note: Bacon nutrition read from the photographed package: 90 calories, 6 g protein, 6 g fat and 0 g carbohydrate per two slices. Two large hard-boiled eggs estimated at about 156 calories, 13 g protein, 11 g fat and 1 g carbohydrate. Combined values rounded; egg size and slice weights introduce some uncertainty.

meals.title: Sweetgreen Harvest Bowl
meals.portion_notes: One full individual Harvest Bowl assumed consumed, including the balsamic vinaigrette and goat cheese. Bowl label lists kale x2, wild rice, roasted chicken, apples, sweet potatoes and roasted almonds. No other bowls, sides or drinks counted.
meals.estimate_note: Uses Sweetgreen's published standard Harvest Bowl nutrition (760 calories, 40 g protein, 60 g carbohydrate, 42 g fat; https://www.sweetgreen.com/nutrition). This is the regular Harvest Bowl, not the Autumn Harvest Bowl. Actual portions and dressing consumption are unmeasured; calorie range is a practical portion estimate, not official uncertainty.

meals.title: Gion Tsujiri matcha roll cookie
meals.portion_notes: One matcha-filled roll cookie (8 g), not the 15-piece box.
meals.estimate_note: Nutrition read directly from the photographed package's per-piece label. Quantity one reported; label values may be rounded.

meals.title: Protein shake
meals.portion_notes: One full Fairlife Core Power Elite chocolate 42 g protein bottle (414 ml), assumed to be the usual product.
meals.estimate_note: Uses the previously verified usual Fairlife bottle nutrition. Product variant and full-bottle portion inferred from the report; only this one newly reported bottle is counted.

meals.title: Hem by Lequy grilled pork vermicelli and spring roll
meals.portion_notes: One full Grilled Pork Vermicelli bowl and one Traditional Spring Roll (half of the two-roll order). No other dishes counted. Assumes a standard restaurant bowl and a modest amount of dressing and dipping sauce.
meals.estimate_note: Portion-based estimate, not official restaurant nutrition: grilled pork vermicelli bowl about 780 calories, 37 g protein, 95 g carbohydrate and 28 g fat; one fresh rice-paper spring roll with shrimp, sliced meat, vegetables and some dipping sauce about 170 calories, 8 g protein, 20 g carbohydrate and 6 g fat. Noodle and pork quantities, cooking oil and sauce consumption are unmeasured.

meals.title: North Coast Organic Honeycrisp applesauce
meals.portion_notes: One full 4 oz (113 g) cup assumed consumed. Product and cup size identified from the package; no other items counted.
meals.estimate_note: Uses published retailer nutrition for the matching Honeycrisp applesauce, per 4 oz serving: 70 calories, 18 g carbohydrate, 0 g protein and 0 g fat. Nutrition panel is not visible on this cup; full-cup intake is assumed and label values may be rounded.

meals.title: Chobani mixed berry vanilla protein yogurt drink
meals.portion_notes: Breakfast: one full 10 fl oz (295 ml) bottle assumed consumed.
meals.estimate_note: Matching product nutrition published by H-E-B and Pret: 170 calories, 20 g protein, 14 g carbohydrate and 3 g fat per bottle. Product and size identified from the photo; front label confirms 20 g protein. Full nutrition panel not visible; label rounding and formulation differences may apply.

meals.title: Cashews
meals.portion_notes: Breakfast: four whole cashews, estimated at about 6.3 g.
meals.estimate_note: Estimated using typical plain cashew nutrition and approximately 18 kernels per ounce. Nut size and preparation are unknown; no additional coatings counted.

meals.title: Gion Tsujiri matcha roll cookie
meals.portion_notes: Breakfast: one matcha-filled roll cookie (8 g), same product as previously logged.
meals.estimate_note: Uses the previously photographed per-piece package label. One additional cookie reported; label values may be rounded.

meals.title: MIXT Orchard salad with blackened chicken
meals.portion_notes: Lunch: one full Orchard salad with blackened chicken replacing the standard grilled chicken; full balsamic vinaigrette assumed.
meals.estimate_note: Calculated from MIXT's published ingredient nutrition: standard Orchard 875 kcal, subtract grilled chicken (120 kcal, 28 g protein), add blackened chicken (160 kcal, 22 g protein). Ingredient totals give 45 g protein, 33 g carbohydrate and 69.5 g fat after the swap. Includes bacon, cheddar, almonds, avocado and full dressing. Standard portions and chicken substitution are assumed; actual serving and dressing consumption may vary.
